purpose.zh: 练托马斯所需的分腿支撑力量
purpose.en: Build straddle support strength for flares.

text.zh: 手臂锁直推地，把髋和双腿撑离地面
text.en: Lock your arms, push the floor and lift your hips and legs off the ground

text.zh: 宽分腿坐，双手在两腿之间撑地
text.en: Sit in a wide straddle with your hands on the floor between your legs.

text.zh: 肩往下压，身体前倾，保持住
text.en: Press your shoulders down, lean forward and hold.

cautions.zh: 手腕热身后再做；腕部或肩部疼痛时缩短时间或改简单版本
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first; if your wrists or shoulders hurt, shorten the hold or use an easier version.
